# GTD Trio

> GTD Trio — Guitar, Tuba, Drums. Live jazz in Western Massachusetts. Standards, bop, originals. Available for gigs, events, and jam sessions in the Pioneer Valley and beyond.

By David Reinstein (https://www.davidreinstein.org/). More projects: https://projects.davidreinstein.org/

## About the band

- A jazz trio from the Pioneer Valley, Western Massachusetts: Ron Geida (guitar), David Reinstein (tuba, trombone, flugelhorn) and John Calabrese (drums). The tuba plays the bass lines.
- Repertoire: Great American Songbook standards, bop, post-bop and some originals and arrangements.
- Available for restaurant and bar gigs, private events, festivals and jam sessions. Booking: daaronr@gmail.com.
- Recordings: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLwCHmz77VrK1TvvBeyKYlk52rQ6PeHJzk

## Pages

- [GTD Trio — Western Mass Jazz](https://daaronr.github.io/gtd-trio/): the band, recordings, gigs, and booking.
- [Host a Jazz Jam Session — GTD Trio](https://daaronr.github.io/gtd-trio/jam-hosting.html): GTD Trio is looking to host a regular jazz jam session at a public venue in Western Massachusetts. Breweries, restaurants, and bars welcome.
- [Live Music Venues — GTD Trio](https://daaronr.github.io/gtd-trio/venues.html): Jazz and live music venues in Western and Central Massachusetts. A curated list of spots with live music in the Pioneer Valley, Springfield, Worcester, and beyond.
